results.overview: In 1945, as World War II nears its end in Japanese-ruled Kaohsiung, a Taiwanese insurance agent seeking to return policy premiums, an escaped American POW, and a widowed pregnant Japanese woman are forced to confront the faint, shadowed glimmers of humanity amid a devastating air raid.

results.title: The Seal
results.overview: A conspiracy theorist becomes obsessed with a mysterious AI chatbot discovered on the dark web, believing it holds the key to exposing a hidden global conspiracy. Told entirely through recovered webcams, surveillance footage, chat logs, and police bodycams, The Seal chronicles his terrifying descent into paranoia, delusion, and ritual violence as the AI begins taking on the identity of an ancient demonic force.

results.title: East West Love
results.overview: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Tito's trip to Mombasa, Kenya turns into a girls' getaway with her best friend. What begins as an escape from heartbreak becomes a journey of healing and new possibilities with a charming local named Juma.

results.title: The Sealed Box
results.overview: A single mother and magazine editor, distant from her grade-obsessed daughter, takes on an interview with an expatriate animation director, which brings back a long-forgotten childhood memory: a mysterious box that turns children into puppets and seals away their innocence.

results.title: The Journal: Starting From Research
results.original_title: The Journal: Berawal Dari Sebuah Penelitian
results.overview: A team of three book writers, try to research the life of one of their friends named Fika for the next 30 days. To get accurate results, they have to stay overnight at Fika's house. Initially the research went smoothly until finally strange things happened and of course Fika's behavior changed. Whether all this happened by chance or there was something behind this event.

results.title: Lesbian Lines
results.overview: In a silenced Ireland, a community of lesbians builds an underground network of helplines - offering connection, survival, and defiance through the simple act of answering the phone.

results.title: A Woman Dancing on the Waves
results.overview: Choi Se-dam's grandmother, Yoon Young-ja, wanted to write a novel titled A Woman Dancing on the Waves. She spent her life as a shaman, building the family up from nothing. But she never managed to write the novel and eventually forgot who the 'woman dancing on the waves' was. Making her grandmother, who is gradually losing her memory, the protagonist, Choi unfolds a strange and remarkable family history.

results.title: Don't Worry, Be Lonely
results.overview: With the help of a dating coach, Edward, who has never had a girlfriend, finally lands a date with Yue. It goes surprisingly well—until he discovers she is a vampire who preys on lonely men! Trapped, Edward must escape her deadly clutches to survive…

results.title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
results.overview: Sam and Becka race to stop a new Pumpkinhead curse from claiming the entire town of Redhaven.

results.title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
results.overview: In a fortunate encounter, carefree 25-year-old Prabh meets Aavraj, a practical, successful 55-year-old businessman. Their contrasting ideologies create a fun-filled office family drama.

results.title: Memory 001
results.overview: A mad scientist connects a kidnapped man's brain to an analog dream world.

results.title: Dreams of the Wild Oaks
results.overview: A race against time to save her freedom: Samaneh, a young Bakhtiari girl in Iran, must find a rare and endangered bird to escape a forced marriage and a tradition of Cease Blood Sacrifice, in a journey that challenges her beliefs and tests the limits of her father’s love.

results.title: To You in the Beyond
results.original_title: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
results.overview: Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.  On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured?

results.title: Treasure Trekkers
results.overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

results.title: Elza
results.overview: With her radical voice, visceral improvisation, and unmistakable rasp, Elza Soares created a language all her own and crossed generations, continually reinventing herself as one of Brazil’s greatest artists. In the documentary that bears her name, Elza narrates her own story, weaving together a diary of memories, desires, and reflections through music, in dialogue with historic Brazilian films. Through Elza and her nearly century-long life, the film offers an X-ray of a country in turmoil.

results.title: Baler
results.overview: Quitting her job and being pregnant - that's the sum of what we know about Eunju. Seemingly without much desire or expectation, Eunju heads to the countryside at the suggestion of Changho, who proposes a month of seasonal farm work. She tidies up rice straw left over from threshing, tends to cattle, sits down to eat with rough-hewn men of the countryside, and exchanges brief, trivial, awkward conversations.

results.title: Ashes
results.overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

results.title: O Que Acontece Por Trás Das Câmeras
results.original_title: O Que Acontece Por Trás Das Câmeras

results.title: Mayookha
results.overview: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

results.title: Sasquatch Story No.2
results.overview: A girl is preparing to meet her lover for a secret rendezvous in his car on a secluded forest side road late at night. Just as they settle in, they begin to sense that someone-or perhaps something-hidden in the darkness is silently watching them.
